Pixel formats:
I.... = Supported Input  format for conversion
.O... = Supported Output format for conversion
..H.. = Hardware accelerated format
...P. = Paletted format
....B = Bitstream format
FLAGS NAME            NB_COMPONENTS BITS_PER_PIXEL BIT_DEPTHS
-----
IO... yuv420p                3             12      8-8-8
I..P. pal8                   1              8      8
..H.. cuda                   0              0      0
